name: WiredNYC – Certified Buildings
description:
This dataset lists 51 Manhattan office buildings certified under the WiredNYC program, which rates commercial properties on their broadband and telecommunications infrastructure. Each row represents one building and includes its name, street address, BBL (borough-block-lot) identifiers, and certification class (Platinum, Gold, or Silver). The remaining fields describe connectivity and telecom readiness: the number of carriers and internet service providers serving the building, whether fiber and coaxial cable connections are available, the extent of fiber distribution across floors, satellite or fixed wireless availability, the number and diversity of riser spaces, points of entry, designated telecom space, and whether agreements and support for new service providers are in place. A list of specific provider names is also included. Geographic fields cover latitude and longitude, community board and council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), neighborhood tabulation area, and ZIP code.

Because the sample covers only Manhattan, it is best suited to comparing buildings within that borough rather than citywide
